fields.label: State
fields.options:
submitted
running
completed
failed
stale
timed_out
cancelled

fields.description: Which app's working tree the sandbox checked out and tested.
fields.label: Target App

fields.description: The Dev Agent's own delegated process instance that dispatched this run.
fields.label: Caller Instance

fields.description: Spiff task UUID of the parked Service Task. This is what a resume targets.
fields.label: Caller Workflow Task ID

fields.description: Set only when this run was dispatched from inside an ai_agent tool call (e.g. Dev Agent's own reasoning step calling dispatch_to_sandbox as a tool) rather than from a plain, top-level Service Task. When set, the callback resumes via the AI Agent Run's checkpoint (kind="human_resume") instead of the kind="agent_sandbox_result" path caller_wf_task_id alone drives.
fields.label: Caller Agent Run

fields.description: Set once the parked step has been handed a resume job. Stops a finished run being woken twice, and stops one that finished between checks being missed.
fields.label: Resume Enqueued

fields.description: The exact JSON body POSTed to the sandbox's /run — the resolved agent_config, target app, branch, and callback URL. Kept for audit; never re-derived from this row.
fields.label: Request Payload

fields.description: The sandbox's callback body as received (status, stdout/stderr tails, sandbox_env).
fields.label: Result

fields.description: The {path: content} dict of changed files the sandbox returned, if the run produced any — the sandbox itself opens the pull request from these directly, this is kept for audit.
fields.label: Files

fields.description: Set once the sandbox reports a pull request was opened successfully (see pr_url/pr_error in its callback body).
fields.label: Pull Request URL

fields.description: The coding loop's own AI Agent Run — created from the callback's agent_usage/agent_tool_calls/agent_model, since the loop runs entirely outside Frappe and has no other way to be tracked. Cost, tokens, and tool calls for the sandbox's own coding turn live there, not on this row.
fields.label: AI Agent Run

fields.description: Set only on the automatic re-dispatch after a test failure — points at the run that failed and triggered it. A run with this set is itself never retried again, however it turns out: retry policy is once, not a loop.
fields.label: Retry Of

fields.description: Time minting the identity token.
fields.label: Token Ms

fields.description: Round trip of the call to the sandbox as Processa saw it. For a parked run this is only the hand-over.
fields.label: Http Ms

fields.description: Total time inside the sandbox, as it reported.
fields.label: Sandbox Ms

fields.description: Time on git (checkout, fetch, commit, push) inside the sandbox.
fields.label: Git Ms

fields.description: Time in the file tool itself inside the sandbox.
fields.label: Tool Ms

fields.description: Time migrating the sandbox site.
fields.label: Migrate Ms

fields.description: Time running the tests.
fields.label: Test Ms

fields.description: Time opening the pull request, tests included.
fields.label: Pr Ms
Action
fields.description: What was asked of the sandbox: read_file, edit_file, run_tests, open_pull_request and so on.

fields.label: Work Item
fields.description: The Work Item the run was for, or an eval case id.

fields.label: Failure Class
fields.options:
infra
model-api
env
code
gave-up
not-reproducible
policy
fields.description: Why a failed, stale or timed-out run ended, so the retry rules can act on it.

fields.label: Commit
fields.description: The commit a test run ran against, so a failing and a passing run can be tied to the code.
